execution_order.title: Create sandbox Entra security groups aligned to dashboard personas
execution_order.rollback: Delete sandbox-only groups and remove test assignments.

execution_order.title: Enable sandbox MFA and report-only Conditional Access for admin personas
execution_order.rollback: Disable the report-only policies and revert pilot assignments.

execution_order.title: Create SharePoint sandbox site and disable external sharing by default
execution_order.rollback: Remove the sandbox site collection and restore default sharing values.

execution_order.title: Publish test-only sensitivity labels and audit baseline
execution_order.rollback: Unpublish the test labels and remove test DLP rules.

restrictions: no permanent Global Administrator standing access
no project data ownership changes through M365
no DLP or CA policy editing

allowed_actions: review shared content in approved locations
access internal collaboration tools from assigned records

restrictions: no external sharing rollout in development

shared_mailboxes: Use role mailboxes for departments only, never as the system of record for project state.
Each shared mailbox must have two named business owners and one technical owner.
Mailbox access must be group-based and quarterly reviewed.
external_sharing: Development remains internal-only for SharePoint and OneDrive.
Do not test external guest flows in the primary dev tenant without security approval.
Use dedicated sandbox guests if external behavior must be validated later.
sensitivity_labels: Publish sandbox labels only: Internal, Internal Restricted, Client Controlled.
Do not auto-apply encryption in development unless testing a specific label workflow.
Use labels to prove taxonomy and publishing logic before production enforcement.
audit_and_retention: Keep Microsoft unified audit enabled for all supported workloads.
Retain sandbox audit logs long enough to validate integrations and admin actions.
Review audit ownership with security before staging promotion.
automation_ownership: All Power Automate flows in development must use named owners, not personal-only ownership.
Custom connectors require platform admin review before creation.
Development flows cannot become the workflow source of truth.

manual_admin_checklist.step: Create sandbox security groups using the PMC-DEV prefix.
Configure report-only MFA and admin Conditional Access pilot for security admins and platform admins.
Set SharePoint and OneDrive external sharing to internal-only.
Enable unified audit and confirm mailbox/site auditing is on.

validation_checklist: Confirm development tenant uses sandbox-only groups and site naming.
Confirm no external sharing is available in SharePoint or OneDrive.
Confirm admin personas can pass MFA and staff do not receive admin center access.
Confirm Power Automate flows are tagged as development-owned and non-production.
rollback_principles: Roll back by unassigning pilot groups before deleting policies.
Revert report-only policies before removing supporting groups and labels.
Never leave orphaned shared mailbox or site owners after rollback.
